title: Claude 1.0
author: Shayan Mohammadi
desc: A 7-day return-to-training block combining 4 strength/functionality days, 2 easy aerobic runs, and 1 full rest day. Built for someone coming back from a lumbar disc injury and managing recurring shin overload — no deadlifts, no squats, no crunches. Strength days use hip-hinge and unilateral leg work instead of axial loading, with disc-safe anti-flexion/anti-rotation core work. Two plyo blocks specifically target landing mechanics: knee tracking/valgus correction (Monday) and foot-strike/ankle stiffness (Thursday) to address the running-form issue behind the shin pain. Light calisthenics (push-up and pull-up progressions) is folded into the upper days rather than given its own session. Goal is to rebuild strength and run capacity safely before increasing training load toward marathon prep.

ex.n: Single-Leg Drop And Stick (20 Cm Step)

ex.note: Side-lying. Top arm opens to ceiling. Breathe into rotation. No force.

ex.n: Ankle Dorsiflexion Rocks - Knee To Wall
ex.note: Foot 10 cm from wall. Push knee over little toe. Heel must not lift.
Low amplitude. Feet cycle under hips. Land midfoot. Think hot coals.
Drive knee up. Foot strikes under centre of mass on way down. Low amplitude.
Stay on ball of foot. No heel contact. Stiff ankle. Small and fast.
Short jump, land in athletic position. Absorb over 2 s. Knee over toe, midfoot.
Rear foot elevated. Front knee over toe. Upright torso. Weak leg first.
Hinge at hip. Rear leg rises as counterbalance. Spine neutral throughout.
Drive through heel on box. 3 s controlled lowering. Don't push off floor leg.

ss.note: RPE 6-7. Bottom knee bent. Hip stack. Don't rotate. Progress duration before difficulty.

ex.note: Sit on bench. DB on knees. Rise on forefoot, lower slow. Isolates soleus from gastroc.
Alternate lifting big toe only, then small toes. Then arch scrunch without curling toes.
Band at face height. Pull to ears, elbows high. Squeeze rear delts at end range.
Dead hang. Pull scapulae down and together without bending elbows. Hold 2 s.
Cat-cow x5, then thread-the-needle rotation x5 each side. Slow.
RPE 7. Bench at 45 deg, lie prone. Row to hips not chest. Squeeze mid-back. No lumbar extension.
RPE 7. Tall posture. Row to lower chest. Squeeze rhomboids 2 s hold. Control the return.

ss.note: RPE 6. Rope at eye level. Pull to ears, elbows high. External rotation at end range.
RPE 7. Neutral grip (thumbs up). Full extension at bottom. No swinging. 2 s eccentric.

ex.note: NEGATIVES: jump to top, lower 3-5 s. BANDED: enough assistance for 5 clean reps. Log band/weight. Goal: 5 clean pull-ups in 8-10 weeks.
RPE 7. Walk tall. Don't lean. Grip failing = set done. Record weight used.
